items.quote: the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Jacob, commanding him to return to his country and kindred and promising to deal well with him

items.quote: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant
items.claim: Jacob asserts that he is unworthy of the mercies and truth that God has shown him

items.quote: with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands
items.claim: Jacob crossed the Jordan with only a staff and has now become two bands
